title: Pxet elite ambushes
summary: Build the four elite counters by defeating the designated Ferubi defenders.
overview: Ferubi tracks separate counters for the elite Blademaster, Spearmaster, Hammermaster and Brawler. Each elite appears when its own counter reaches 100 qualifying death signals.
Only designated spawn points contribute. Killing an arbitrary creature of the same name does not necessarily advance a counter.

sections.title: Independent elite counters
paragraphs: The counters persist between controller spawns. When an elite is triggered, its counter resets three seconds later; the other three counters continue independently.

notes: Approved row E121. Quest source reviewed; live encounter behavior and loaded database spell/loot data have not been verified.
The source identifies eligible spawn-point IDs, but their current database placement and the elite NPC spell/loot data still need verification.
